content: ह्रस्व {%a.%} [ह्रस्-वन्] (<ab>compar.</ab> ह्रसीयस्; <ab>superl.</ab> ह्रसिष्ठ) .²1 Short, small, little. .²2 Dwarfish, low or short in stature. .²3 Short (<ab>opp.</ab> to दीर्घ in prosody). .²4 Minor, very young in age; जाता ह्रस्वा प्रजा प्रमीयते <ls>Mb. 3. 197. 13</ls>. .²5 Unimportant, insignificant. .{@-स्वः@} .²1 A dwarf. .²2 A short vowel. .{@-स्वम्@} Green or black sulphate of iron.
